name: ASK India Select Portfolio
simpleDescription: Hand-picks 20–25 mid-sized Indian companies with strong management and growth potential. The kind of names you've heard of, but smaller — and faster-growing.
proDescription: Concentrated small-and-midcap PMS targeting businesses with 18%+ ROE, manageable leverage, and a 5-year earnings runway. Benchmark Nifty Midcap 150.

name: White Oak India Pioneers
simpleDescription: Bets on Indian companies that are 'category creators' — businesses leading new industries. Think first movers in EV, clean energy, or fintech.
proDescription: Thematic PMS focused on innovation-led businesses across sustainability, digital infra, and consumption transitions. Concentrated 20–25 names.

name: Blume Ventures Fund IV
simpleDescription: An early-stage VC fund that invests in seed and Series A Indian startups. Long lock-in, high risk, but exposure to companies that may become household names.
proDescription: Category I AIF deploying into pre-seed to Series A across SaaS, fintech, and consumer internet. 10-year fund life with 4-year deployment.

name: IIFL Real Estate Fund Series IV
simpleDescription: Lends to Indian real estate developers and earns interest. Like a fixed deposit, but the return is higher — and your money is locked in for years.
proDescription: Category II AIF providing structured credit to RERA-registered residential developers across Tier 1 cities. Contracted IRR with downside collateral cover.
